english_text: On the other hand , we underline that the compromise found on funding of research using human embryos and human embryonic stem-cells does not reflect the position of the EPP-ED Group as fixed before the first reading in June . We regret that the European Parliament did not support this amendment , especially because only 19 more votes were needed for the necessary majority . We welcome the adoption of FP7 . In a vote after discussion on many occasions , a big majority of the Group supported Amendment 319 by Niebler and others , who sought to fix a deadline . The EPP-ED accepts that , according to the Rules of Procedure of the European Parliament , Amendment 319 can not be tabled for the second reading . This does not change the position of the EPP-ED Group in this area .
